reviews.author: Malinda Fisher
reviews.text: We needed some snow guards powder coated for a client of ours, and this company was recommended to me by multiple people... I can see why! Barry and his team were professional, had great communication, were very flexible and accommodating during the whole process. The product they delivered was simply magnificent! You can tell they have a passion for this.

reviews.author: Dustin Yingst
reviews.text: Finish Line did a great job at a great price. Next time I need something powder coated it’s going to finish line for sure

reviews.author: Christina T
reviews.text: Barry Lowe at Finish Line Powder Coating did a great job restoring a 20 year old patio table and chairs to "new". I was thrilled to see the final product and he was good about returning calls. He picks up and delivers. This is a great alternative to new especially when new isn't available and prices are soaring. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: joey bedrosian
reviews.text: Not sure why there are so many bad reviews. I took some motorcycle parts to Barry and he did a great job and got it done in less than a week. I called around for prices first and initially thought they were more expensive than everyone else, but then realized he included blasting in his pricing and no one else does. He coated all the right spots and just blasted all the areas that couldn't be coated. Top notch work and glad to know I got someone good for my next project.

reviews.author: Dana Simmons
reviews.text: I was looking for powder coating for a vintage patio set. I needed pick up and delivery as well. Barry, the owner personally picked it up and returned it in very good time. It is absolutely beautiful, a smooth flat black surface and new floor protectors. It was more expensive than another firm I tried but I would have rented a pick up to get it back and forth and they estimated twice the time to finish the set. So very happy.
